conditions: The opponent completes a back-pass before the pressure sequence.
A named opposing presser is within {distance} metres of the goalkeeper in the sampled arrival frame.
The pressured pass is incomplete within {responseWindow} seconds.
The pressing team records a regain within {regainWindow} seconds.
The same team produces a cutback, shot, and goal within {outcomeWindow} seconds of the regain.
limitations: This is an unreviewed synthetic demonstration policy, not a league-calibrated threshold set.
Sparse fixture frames are snapshots; they do not establish continuous movement or pressure intensity.
The sequence supports a pressing interpretation but does not establish player intent, manager intent, or causality.
